Title: Button
Prompt: Write the button label as a verb that names the result. Give two options. Do not use 'submit' unless I say the user understands it.

Title: Empty state
Prompt: Write the empty state: what is missing, and the action that creates the first one. Do not be cute.

Title: Error
Prompt: Write the error. Include what the person can do next. Do not blame them. Do not mention a stack trace.

Title: Confirm
Prompt: Write the confirm title and body. Name the thing being deleted. Do not say 'are you sure?' alone.

Title: Success
Prompt: Write the success message and where the person should look next.
Check: It does not claim an email was sent unless I said so.

Title: Shorter
Prompt: Cut the string to the character count I give you. Do not change the meaning.
